title: The script next to the camera you chose
description: The text helps record video in the way that already suits the author.

blocks.text: A built-in camera does not always give the sound, the lens or the mode you need. A teleprompter is useful as part of another recording process too.

quote.text: It forces you to stay in the app to record. It won’t let you use it with TikTok, IG, or any other platform beyond its own! Waste of money!

blocks.text: Define the supported combinations and offer a clear way to position the text. Keep the size, width and pace settings.
What is possible depends on the platform and on the camera app. The product description needs tested scenarios, not a promise that it works over everything.
